name: Linux Fundamentals: The Night Shift
description: You are the overnight operator at the Meridian Observatory. The day crew left the dome in a state, the night log needs reading, and nobody is coming to help until dawn. Starts at "where am I?" and ends with you writing a pipeline. No prior experience assumed.
// scene: The wide establishing shot across the top of the briefing: the place the story opens. Optional. Same image rules as cover -- raster only, never SVG, never a web address. Pairs with reveal, which is the same place once the story has ended.
// reveal: The picture the class uncovers together, one square per find. Embedded, so a pack stays one file. Raster only -- never SVG.
// revealCaption: The line printed under the picture when the last square turns over. It names what the class uncovered, so the picture is the end of the scenario rather than decoration. It must never contain an answer -- a class finishes the picture before its slowest student finishes the pack.
revealCaption: Dawn over Meridian. The night log is read, the handover note is written and the dome is shut. The day crew are driving up the mountain, and they will find everything where it should be.

briefing.heading: The Night Shift
briefing.body:
It is 21:40 and the dome is yours until sunrise.

The day crew went home in a hurry. The night log is half-written, files are in the wrong folders, and the handover note for the morning shift does not exist yet. Everything you need is on this machine, and the only way to reach any of it is the terminal in front of you.

Nothing here can break. Try a command, read what comes back, and try another. When you are stuck, the first hint on every challenge is free and costs you nothing.
youWillLearn: Move around a filesystem and always know where you are
Read, create, copy, move and delete files without fear
Search text with grep, and count what you find
Chain commands that depend on each other succeeding

acts.name: Act I: Opening the Dome
acts.tagline: Learn the building before dark: paths, listings, files, and wildcards

acts.name: Act II: Reading the Night Log
acts.tagline: Filter, count, sort and pipe what the observatory recorded

acts.name: Act III: Keys to the Dome
acts.tagline: Create, copy, move, remove, and decide who may read what
acts.// unlockThreshold: Act II grew from 11 to 13 challenges (sort split in two, uniq added). The house default of 0.8 would raise this act's requirement from 9 solves to 11, so a student sitting between those two numbers -- who had already unlocked Act III -- would find it re-locked. 0.65 keeps the requirement at 9, same as before the content pass.

acts.name: Act IV: Handover at Dawn
acts.tagline: Find, edit, test and chain — everything the day crew will not do for you
acts.// unlockThreshold: Act III grew from 11 to 12 challenges (&& moved here from Act IV, ahead of the boss). The house default of 0.8 would raise this act's requirement from 9 solves to 10, re-locking a student sitting at exactly 9. 0.75 keeps the requirement at 9.
